title: At the Beach
description: Nam has a fun day at the beach.
instructions: Read about Nam at the beach. Then choose the right answer.

paragraphs.text: 🏖️ Nam is at the beach with his mum and dad. It is a hot, sunny day.
Nam has got a red bucket and a blue spade. He makes a big sand castle.
His sister Linh is in the sea. She can swim. She has got a yellow ball.
Nam sees two small crabs under a rock. Then he finds three shells.
Mum has got ice creams. Nam likes strawberry ice cream. Linh likes banana ice cream.
